item.title: U.S. Senate CLARITY Act faces collapse before August recess; Galaxy Digital cuts passage odds to 30% with seven Democrats still opposed.
Senate Republicans release CLARITY Act update banning officials from holding crypto tokens; ethics provision set to expire in 2029.
Three cross-chain bridges lose $35.5M in six hours: AFX Arbitrum bridge $24.2M, Verus Ethereum bridge $7.5M, B2 Network $3.9M.
SEC advancing three July crypto proposals covering token offerings, broker-dealer custody, and digital-asset trading venues.
CFTC's window for 24/7 perpetual-style bitcoin futures expires July 27, three months after the first regulated product launched on Kalshi.
OCC closed its comment period July 24 on proposed GENIUS Act stablecoin reserve and custody standards, advancing the rulemaking timeline.
U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs shed $465M over two sessions, reversing a five-day, $727M inflow streak amid risk-off sentiment.
U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs logged five consecutive net-inflow days totaling $727M in late July, the first such streak since April.
One year after the GENIUS Act's enactment, the U.S. stablecoin market reaches $310B as federal stablecoin rules remain unfinished.
CLARITY Act stablecoin yield rules finalized in latest draft as negotiators seek bipartisan support before Congress's August recess.
Cardano lending platform SecondFi is shutting down after an exploit drained 16.1M ADA ($2.4M) from 374 customer wallets.
Balance Coin stablecoin collapsed 99% after an oracle manipulation attack drained $1M from its bitcoin vaults.
